title: The Boy and the Nettles
summary: A boy touched a stinging nettle lightly with his fingertip and was severely stung. Weeping, he told his mother: "I touched it so gently!"...
full_text:
A boy touched a stinging nettle lightly with his fingertip and was severely stung. Weeping, he told his mother: "I touched it so gently!"

His mother answered: "That is why it stung you! Next time, grasp the nettle boldly and firmly with a resolute hand, and its bristles will feel as soft as silk without stinging."
moral: Grasp difficult tasks with bold resolution; timid hesitation brings stinging pain.
